title: Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage — Hospital-Day Reversals in a Paid Coinsurance Block
content:
**Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage — hospital days and the card payment.** A day reversed as a hospital day is not a covered day: when the paid block's booked-days entry carries a hospital-day reversal, its reversed days inside the paid block come off the days the card payment counts before the supplemental effective date, all of them when its last reversed day falls before that date, those from its first reversed day up to the day before the date when the date falls after its first reversed day and on or before its last, and none otherwise; without such a reversal, none come off.

The reversal is a reversal of booked days with the reason hospital day, posted against the paid block's own booked-days entry in the episode's Medicare billing history; its first and last reversed days are its span.

| Supplemental effective date compared with the reversed days inside the paid block | Days that come off |
|---|---|
| Falls after the last reversed day | Every reversed day inside the paid block |
| Falls after the first reversed day and on or before the last | From the first reversed day up to the day before the date |
| Any other position | None |
| No such reversal on the entry | None |

*Hypothetical worked example:* the entry carries a hospital-day reversal for the 21st to the 24th. With a supplemental effective date of the 23rd, the 21st and 22nd come off; with the 27th, all four days come off; with the 19th, none.
